what: photon multipole magnitudes at a=0.0011, k=0.1005/Mpc, after the tau_rem fix
reading: With tcu=False AND rsa_g=False, the clamp mask is false, so dY for l>=2 should be non-zero -- yet every multipole from l=2 up is exactly 0 after 300 steps of dln a = 2e-4. Either the l>=2 rows are still being zeroed, or the initial state plus one short march cannot populate them. This is the next thing to check: it would explain why lmax 24 vs 48 is bit-identical (those rows carry no information) and why the high-k residual does not respond to any switch.
